The Nigerian FOOTBALL team has many foreign players.
33550.explanation: In responding to questions on emphatic stress in examinations, interrogative sentences will be provided as options. The interrogative sentence that contradicts the emphasised word is the correct option. Option B is the correct answer here because the word ''Volleyball contradicts Football''.

options.text: Does the South African football team have many foreign players?
Does the Nigerian volleyball team have many foreign players?
Does the Nigerian football team have foreign players?
Does the Nigerian football team have many foreign coaches?

options.text: Must Jane pay for the broken glass immediately?
must John repair the broken glass immediately?
must John pay for the broken glass immediately?
must John pay for broken glass immediately?

40422.explanation: The test seemed so simple that we thought we would all pass.

40423.subject: English Language
40423.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

Good citizens are expected to abide........ the stipulated laws.
40423.explanation: Good citizens are expected to abide by  the stipulated laws.

40424.subject: English Language
40424.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

In the olden days, people gave cowries ........... food.
40424.explanation:
In the olden days, people gave cowries in exchange for  food.

In exchange for; when something is given up to get another

40425.subject: English Language
40425.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

The man tried to cash in ........ the boy's ignorance.
40425.explanation:
The man tried to cash in on the boy's ignorance.

Cash in on; means take advantage of or exploit (a situation).

40426.subject: English Language
40426.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

Adamu studied very hard ........ passing the examination.
40426.explanation: with a view to; means with the hope, aim, or intention of.

40427.subject: English Language
40427.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

No sooner had the judge read the verdict ......... pandemonium broke out.
40427.explanation: No sooner had the judge read the verdict  than  pandemonium broke out.

40428.subject: English Language
40428.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

I could not distinguish the original ......... the fake.
40428.explanation: From; indicating the point in time at which a particular process, event, or activity starts.

40429.subject: English Language
40429.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

When I came home, my mother asked me if I ............
40429.explanation: We use the past perfect tense (had eaten) when a past action occurs before (or leads up to) another past action.

40430.subject: English Language
40430.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

Uncle Richard invited Naza and ............ to his house.
40430.explanation:
Uncle Richard invited Naza and me to his house.

'me' is used as the object of a verb to refer to the receiver of an action

40431.subject: English Language
40431.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

My sister prides herself .......... her cooking.

40432.subject: English Language
40432.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

I suppose it's high time we .......... attention to our studies.
40432.explanation:
I suppose it's high time we paid   attention to our studies.

Paid; is the past and past participle of pay.

40433.subject: English Language
40433.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

We were expecting them in the evening but they arrived ........... dawn.
40433.explanation:
We were expecting them in the evening but they arrived  at  dawn.

At; expressing location or arrival in a particular place or position.

40434.subject: English Language
40434.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

Children often try to live up ........ their parents' expectations.

40435.subject: English Language
40435.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

He ........ be fat, but he is still smart.
40435.explanation: He may be fat, but he is still smart.

40436.subject: English Language
40436.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

The students had no choice ........... to do as they had been commanded.
40436.explanation: If you have no choice but to do something or have little choice but to do it, you cannot avoid doing it. They had little choice but to agree to what he suggested.

40437.subject: English Language
40437.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

The dog was run........ by a careless driver.
40437.explanation: Run over; to hit someone or something with a vehicle and drive over them.

40438.subject: English Language
40438.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

When will the strike be ...........?

40439.subject: English Language
40439.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

I received an award ....... my outstanding performance in the debate.
40439.explanation: I received an award for my outstanding performance in the debate.

40440.subject: English Language
40440.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

The earlier we leave, ......... for us.
40440.explanation: You say the sooner/earlier the better when you think something should be done as soon as possible.e.g The kidnapper is a man we must catch and the sooner the better.

40441.subject: English Language
40441.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

I just couldn't .......... what he was saying.
40441.explanation: Make out; means to be able to see, hear, read, or distinguish something despite difficulty, often due to factors that interfere with one's senses. In this usage, a noun or pronoun can be used between "make" and "out." e.g If we turn up the volume we may be able to make out what they're saying

40442.subject: English Language
40442.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

The men were charged ......... murder.
40442.explanation:
Charged = formally accuse (someone) of something, especially an offence under law.

Example = they were charged with assault

40443.subject: English Language
40443.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

It is I who ......... to blame for the lapses.
40443.explanation: The Rule of Concord states that the noun or pronoun that comes before the relative pronoun determines the verb form that follows.

40444.subject: English Language
40444.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

We had to look ........ the word in the dictionary.
40444.explanation: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it out by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

40445.subject: English Language
40445.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

Each of the winners ........ to receive five thousand dollars.
40445.explanation:
The correct option to complete the sentence is:

B. is

So the complete sentence would be: "Each of the winners is to receive five thousand dollars."

In this sentence, "each" is an indefinite pronoun and indefinite pronouns are treated as singular pronouns, so it should be followed by the singular form of the verb, which is "is."

40446.subject: English Language
40446.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

Everyone was happy when the two friends made....... after their disagreement.
40446.explanation: Made up; to forgive someone and be friendly with them again after an argument or disagreement:

40447.subject: English Language
40447.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

It is rude to cut ......... when people are talking.
40447.explanation: cut in; To interrupt someone while they are speaking.

40448.subject: English Language
40448.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

I........ a song when I got my letter of promotion.
40448.explanation: If someone breaks into something they suddenly start doing it.

40449.subject: English Language
40449.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

Our tour of the tower came to an end all ....... soon.
40449.explanation:
Our tour of the tower came to an end all too soon.

Too; to a higher degree than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively.

40450.subject: English Language
40450.question_text:
From the words or group of words lettered A to D, choose the word or group of words that best completes the sentence.

The ....... of the various dailies attended the conference.
40450.explanation:
Editors-in-Chief; the principal editor of a publication, responsible for managing editorial policies and the production of content.

The plural form of editor in chief is editors in chief.
